name: My Love Life With Lycanthropy: Elixir for Loneliness
source:
Follows the werewolf adventurer Caroline Zervas as she finds herself under the care of a wealthy alchemist. As Caroline decides whether or not she wants to give up her life on the road for a more peaceful one, she starts to admire her host more and more. What follows is a cute, sexy, funny and sometimes heartfelt story about managing mental illness and finding a home in a world that isn't built for you.

[From [url=https://rambrandt.itch.io/my-love-life-with-lycanthropy-elixer-for-loneliness]Itch.io[/url]]
